statusLegend.run: downloaded and executed in this repo's harness (validation/run.js); quality audited
statusLegend.page-read: the dataset's own page or README was read; contents NOT downloaded here
statusLegend.search-only: seen in search results only; not opened. Treat every field as unverified
statusLegend.gated: needs a signed agreement or an application; cannot be fetched automatically
statusLegend.blocked-here: exists and is open, but the host is unreachable from this GitHub-only environment

datasets.name: CMU Keystroke Dynamics Benchmark (Killourhy & Maxion 2009)
datasets.license: none stated in the mirror; the original page offers the data for research use
datasets.size: 20,400 samples, 51 typists x 400 repetitions of one password
datasets.quality: 0 invalid, 0 duplicates. One 11-key password typed 400 times: practised, so unusually regular
datasets.uses: false-alarm rate of the typing rules on real people

datasets.name: Aalto 136M Keystrokes
datasets.size: 1.4 GB zipped, 16 GB unzipped; 168,960 participants (per a 2025 survey excerpt)
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: the large free-text human set needed to test any new typing rule; the GitHub repo aalto-ui/136m-keystrokes holds only the collection app

datasets.name: KeyRecs (Dias et al. 2023)
datasets.host: PMC article PMC10474054 links the data
datasets.size: fixed-text and free-text samples with demographics
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: demographic spread for fairness slices

datasets.name: Balabit Mouse Dynamics Challenge
datasets.license: none stated: research use only, do not redistribute
datasets.size: 242 MB, 1,678 files, 10 users; public_labels.csv has 816 test sessions flagged legal/illegal
datasets.labels: human only. The 'illegal' sessions are other users mixed in, not bots (stated in the README)
datasets.quality: 65 training sessions used; 0 invalid. Remote-desktop work, so pointer timing includes network jitter
datasets.uses: human pointer-speed profile (false alarms)

datasets.name: DELBOT Mouse dataset (chrisgdt)
datasets.size: 3,616 sessions: 1,020 human (6 setups incl. trackpad, phone, VM) and 2,596 bot (GAN 1,899; pynput 408; NaturalMouseMotion 234; PyHuman 55)
datasets.labels: human / bot, with generator and capture setup
datasets.quality: 0 duplicates, 0 label conflicts. 68 short sessions kept on purpose. Humans and bots were recorded on different machines (bots mostly 1536x864), so resolution and sample clock are shortcut risks. Each file is one circle click and recording starts at the click, so approach-path features cannot be computed
datasets.uses: bot-vs-human pointer separation; touch-user fairness

datasets.name: SapiMouse
datasets.size: 120 subjects (92 male, 28 female); raw logs on an external host
datasets.labels: human only (plus the authors' SapiAgent paper on GAN bots)
datasets.quality: repo cloned but raw data not fetched
datasets.uses: demographic spread, human baseline

datasets.name: BeCAPTCHA-Mouse benchmark (Acien et al. 2022)
datasets.license: signed licence agreement, emailed to the authors
datasets.size: human trajectories from the Shen et al. database (58 users, >200K) plus GAN-synthetic bot trajectories
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: the standard published bot-mouse benchmark. Apply for it

datasets.name: Web Bot Detection Dataset (ITI / Bournemouth, Iliou et al. 2021)
datasets.size: two phases: 50 and 56 human sessions, with the same number of 'moderate' bot sessions (browser fingerprint) and 'advanced' bot sessions (human-like behaviour). Web logs AND mouse movements per session
datasets.quality: page read, data not downloaded. Participants were the authors and 28 recruited users
datasets.uses: the only public set that pairs logs with mouse for humanlike bots. Top priority to obtain

datasets.name: CaptchaSolve30k (Capycap-AI)
datasets.size: 30,000 sessions, 4.83 GB; 1000 Hz raw mouse stream, 240 Hz game ticks, touchscreen flag
datasets.labels: human only; 3 task types (sheep herding, thread the needle, polygon stacking); no success labels on the page
datasets.quality: page read, data not downloaded. Collected under a stated privacy policy with opt-out; sessions cannot be linked to individuals
datasets.uses: largest human ground truth for movement shape, tracking and drag tasks, with a touch flag. Closest public analogue to the ring and targets tasks

datasets.name: Stroop trial data (erfanjaripour/stroop-interference, from an OSF study)
datasets.license: MIT (repo); the OSF source licence not verified
datasets.size: 48,517 trials, 81 participants; RT in seconds, condition, correctness
datasets.quality: 0 invalid; 10 anticipations (<150 ms); 16,225 neutral trials not used by the product. Keyboard responses, more than two colours
datasets.uses: calibrating the clash window and thresholds

datasets.name: Lakens/Stroop
datasets.size: 131 participants, one row each (stroop.csv)
datasets.quality: NOT FIT FOR USE: one Congruent and one Incongruent value per participant, roughly 15 to 25 (seconds): per-person totals, not per-trial reaction times
datasets.uses: none for this product

datasets.name: Moving Target Selection with Delay datasets (WPI)
datasets.size: four user studies of selecting moving targets under added delay
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: human reaction under latency for the flash and pulse checks

datasets.name: Visuomotor pursuit-tracking studies (PMC13135551, PMC10794298 TRACK)
datasets.size: continuous cursor-vs-target data under varied latency
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: the README's '80-350 ms behind a moving target' claim has no public data behind it in this repo. These papers are where to check it

datasets.name: Finger-tapping sensorimotor-synchronisation studies
datasets.size: metronome and tap onsets, small N (tens of participants)
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: asynchrony norms for the beat check. No large open set found

datasets.name: ASVspoof 2019 / 2021 / 5
datasets.license: 2019 and 5: Open Data Commons attribution (per a guide excerpt); 2021 differs
datasets.size: bona fide and spoofed speech (TTS, voice conversion, replay)
datasets.labels: bona fide / spoof with attack id
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: voice-clone and TTS artifacts. It has no prompt-and-answer timing, so it cannot test our onset-timing rule

datasets.name: mintlify/agent-traffic
datasets.size: 98 curated agents/crawlers/bots, 135 real example user agents, 35 HTTP clients, header rules, verified 2026-10
datasets.labels: agent / ai-crawler / crawler / bot, with kind and operator
datasets.quality: kept; 47 strings carry a different label in the larger crawler list
datasets.uses: ground truth for the agent lane's identity rules

datasets.name: monperrus/crawler-user-agents
datasets.size: about 2,100 real crawler user agents
datasets.quality: 58 exact duplicates removed; 37 entries look like full browser strings (a UA-only rule can never catch them)
datasets.uses: crawler recall at scale

datasets.name: microlinkhq/top-user-agents
datasets.size: 100 current real browser user agents
datasets.quality: clean
datasets.uses: false-positive control for identity rules

datasets.name: Web robot detection - Server logs (Zenodo 3477932)
datasets.size: JSON server logs, IP last 6 digits masked
datasets.labels: unverified: the page excerpt does not say
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: labelled bot vs human logs, if labels are present

datasets.name: ocatak/apache-http-logs
datasets.size: 17,849 requests from Acunetix, Netsparker, w3af (as used by abuseguard's validation)
datasets.quality: not re-run here; abuseguard's own VALIDATION.md reports it
datasets.uses: scanner-style automation; not scraping

datasets.name: elastic/examples nginx and Apache logs
datasets.size: 51,462 and 10,000 real requests, 2015
datasets.quality: per abuseguard's VALIDATION.md: no ground truth, two small old sites
datasets.uses: false-alarm check on quiet legitimate traffic, not an FPR

datasets.name: Web Server Access Logs (eliasdabbas), Zanbil e-commerce 3.3 GB
datasets.size: multi-GB real e-commerce access logs
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: scale test for the audit; audit.js loads the file into memory

datasets.name: captcha_images_v2 (Fournier; mirrored by CaptchaCracker)
datasets.size: 1,040 PNG, label is the file name
datasets.quality: unchecked; small
datasets.uses: text-captcha OCR baseline for the arena

datasets.name: szili2011/captcha-ocr-dataset
datasets.size: about 1.8 million synthetic images
datasets.quality: synthetic, so it says little about real vendors
datasets.uses: training a text-captcha attacker for the arena

datasets.name: ssivakorn/reCAPTCHA-study
datasets.size: unknown (a clone stalled on size)
datasets.labels: reCAPTCHA image challenges collected from real sites, with instruction text
datasets.quality: unchecked
datasets.uses: real reCAPTCHA grid challenges

datasets.name: DannyLuna/recaptcha-classification-57k
datasets.size: model trained on a 57k-image set
datasets.quality: a model card, not the data
datasets.uses: attack baseline

datasets.name: Breaking reCAPTCHAv2 (Plesner et al., ETH, arXiv 2409.08831)
datasets.size: unverified
datasets.labels: YOLO-based solver of reCAPTCHAv2 image challenges
datasets.quality: success figures not re-verified here
datasets.uses: published attack baseline against Google's image captcha

datasets.name: A Low-Cost Attack against the hCaptcha System (arXiv 2104.04683)
datasets.category: G. classic image / vendor attack data
datasets.size: attack reported at more than 95% accuracy in under 19 s per challenge (search excerpt)
datasets.quality: the dataset's availability was not checked
datasets.uses: published attack baseline against hCaptcha

datasets.name: wenlng/go-captcha (click, slide, drag, rotate generator)
datasets.size: an open generator, not a dataset
datasets.labels: generated, so ground truth is known
datasets.quality: n/a
datasets.uses: unlimited labelled slider, rotate and click captchas for attack tests

datasets.name: yujunjiex/behavior_captcha_cracker (GeeTest, Yidun, Yunpian)
datasets.license: GNU, non-commercial; data given by email on request
datasets.size: slider accuracy 99%+ and Yidun click top-1 96% claimed in the README (not verified)
datasets.quality: unchecked; weights not published
datasets.uses: evidence that vendor slider and click captchas are broken by public models

datasets.name: Open CaptchaWorld (NeurIPS 2025 Datasets & Benchmarks)
datasets.size: 20 puzzle types (dice count, slide puzzle, rotation match, click order, hold button, path finder ...), 463 puzzles in July 2025 and more since, each with ground_truth.json
datasets.labels: ground-truth answers; a run harness for browser-use and CrewAI agents
datasets.quality: not downloaded
datasets.uses: ready-made harness to measure how well MLLM agents solve captcha-style puzzles

datasets.name: NextGen-CAPTCHAs (MetaAgentX, 2026)
datasets.size: 519 puzzles, 27 families, announced in the Open CaptchaWorld README
datasets.quality: not opened
datasets.uses: newer MLLM-resistant puzzles to compare design ideas

datasets.name: What Does It Take to Detect an AI Agent? (arXiv 2607.26935, Jul 2026)
datasets.size: controlled benchmark; 2,299 evasion sessions in a five-level evasion ladder
datasets.quality: no dataset or code link on the abstract page. Reports that Playwright does not emit the raw pointer-move and wheel streams a physical device does
datasets.uses: a hypothesis to test: raw event-rate and teleport-click features. Our run could test event rate only

datasets.name: Azure LLM inference traces and BurstGPT
datasets.size: real per-request token counts with no identities
datasets.quality: used by abuseguard's VALIDATION.md, which says the identities and links were invented
datasets.uses: realistic request-cost distributions for ledger caps. There is no public data of real multi-account farms
